changelog.change: Wk 10 tune-up, two small model changes kept: (1) backup / first-time starting QBs (under 60 attempts this season) start from a yards-per-attempt baseline 0.6 lower (it fades as they throw more); (2) catch rate, yards per catch and yards per carry now weight recent games a little more (0.9 per game back).
changelog.why: Wk 9: passing-yards overs on backup / new starters went 0-7 (Fagnano, Milton, McCarthy, Lock, Minshew, Willis, Wentz). Recent-efficiency weighting had helped 2026 before but failed single-seed tests.
changelog.tested: Out of sample, averaged over 4 simulation seeds (new: one seed moves a season's Brier by up to ~0.6 per 1,000, as much as most changes). Overall over/under Brier 2023 0.230169 -> 0.230117, 2024 0.228869 -> 0.228701, 2025 0.227134 -> 0.226854 (past 3: 0.228743 -> 0.228578), 2026 Wks 3-9 0.219379 -> 0.219105; with anytime TD past 3 0.212432 -> 0.212283, 2026 0.208748 -> 0.208527. Better in all 3 past seasons and 2026. Each alone also passed (4 seeds): QB baseline past3 -0.05 / 2026 -0.08 per 1,000 (2026 passing yards -0.72); recent efficiency past3 -0.12 / 2026 -0.18. Rushing props slightly worse (CAR +1.4 per 1,000 in 2026).

changelog.change: Moneylines are no longer used as suggested parlay legs (they stay in the lean log and in Best bets). Anytime-TD picks now need an 8-point edge over the DraftKings price (was 4). Suggested value parlays only use legs the model gives a 44%+ chance (was 40%). Each game page now shows the projected winner and both teams' win chances.
changelog.why: Tristen: a bet with a 30% chance to win isn't a leg worth taking even when the price pays well. Pending Week 9 TD picks under the new bar (8) moved to the TD-chance check before kickoff; graded rows were left as logged.
changelog.tested: Selection rule, not a model change. 2026 TD picks by edge are too few to test (47 graded); the record still grades every pick at its logged price.

changelog.change: Moneyline, spread and total edges are now tracked as leans, not picks, and left out of each game's Best value list. They still show with the model's chance and edge.
changelog.why: Tristen questioned a BAL +390 moneyline pick with JAX a 10-point favorite. Tested on 2022-25 closing lines, betting the model's own game-line edges lost money: moneylines about -97 units (long underdogs -45), spreads -53, totals about even (+3.6). The market's win probabilities were more accurate in every past season.
changelog.tested: Game-line backtest on 2022-25 + 2026 Wks 3-8 as-of builds vs nflverse closing lines (see tuning log, Nov 5).

changelog.change: Target shares now lean halfway (log scale) toward a route-based share: how often a player runs a route when his team drops back (this season's snap counts adjusted by his pass-down tendency from 2024-25 on-field data) times his targets per route (this season plus last season's real figure). Catches role changes that box-score target share misses.
changelog.why: Tristen's call (Nov 4) after the out-of-sample test: real route data helped every past season; this substitute helps most seasons.
changelog.tested: Brier per 1,000 over/unders, avg of 3 seeds: 2022 -1.32, 2023 +0.07, 2024 +0.25, 2025 -0.69, all four past seasons -0.42 (better in every seed), 2026 Wks 3-8 -0.17 (+0.28/-0.14/-0.64 by seed). Receptions improve most (2022 -3.5, 2025 -3.5, 2026 -2.7). Anytime TD slightly worse (about +0.5 per 1,000). Did not meet the standard rule (2 of 4 past seasons better, 1 of 3 seeds pass); added on Tristen's decision.

changelog.change: Track record: anytime-TD props are no longer counted in the win-loss record. TD picks (long-odds bets the model liked at the price) are shown on their own line in units; the other TD props are not bets and are used only to check the model's scoring chances (predicted 20% vs actual 19% so far).
changelog.why: Tristen: counting a player with a ~20% chance not scoring as a lost bet skewed the record (those 705 props went 128-535).
changelog.tested: Display / bookkeeping only; no projection or graded result changed.

changelog.change: Touchdown mix: how many of a team's points come as touchdowns rather than field goals now depends on the matchup. Offenses that rarely go three-and-out and hit more 20+ yard plays, against defenses that allow them, score more of their points as touchdowns (most teams 70-78%, was a flat 74%). Only touchdown props change; yards, catches and carries are exactly as before.
changelog.why: Tristen: look at plays per drive. Drive length itself didn't help, but the two things behind it (three-and-outs and big plays) predict touchdowns vs field goals.
changelog.tested: Anytime-TD and passing-TD props more accurate in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, under three random seeds; overall score better every season. A pace-based drive count was tested too and rejected (helped past seasons, hurt 2026).

changelog.change: Every judgment-set number in the model and simulator was backtested (about 45 settings, each tried higher and lower). Two changed: catch rates now trust the position average for 24 targets instead of 12 before leaning on a player's own catch rate, and a QB's history against this week's defense counts much less (it added almost nothing). Weather adjustments were confirmed to help.
changelog.why: Tristen: test everything that had never been tested.
changelog.tested: Both changes better in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, and still better under two other random seeds. Everything else stayed: alternatives were worse, mixed, or within noise. Takes effect with the Week 9 build.

changelog.change: Added two Next Gen Stats inputs at a light weight: rushing yards over expected now feeds each back's yards per carry, and YAC over expected feeds each receiver's yards per catch (25% weight each). Questionable / doubtful players' chance of playing now comes from their designation and final practice status instead of a flat 80% / 30%.
changelog.why: Tristen: add advanced stats (easy + medium tier) and keep what moves the needle. Nine inputs and 15 combinations were backtested; these two were the only ones that held up (a slightly relaxed rule, approved by Tristen: 2026 may be worse by up to 0.2 per 1,000).
changelog.tested: Overall Brier (per 1,000) vs base: 2023 -0.071, 2024 -0.028, 2025 -0.020, past-3 combined -0.040, 2026 Wks 3-7 +0.088. Playing chance (2023-25 official reports vs snap counts, held out by season): Brier 0.265->0.213 (2023), 0.267->0.206 (2024), 0.282->0.232 (2025), 0.265->0.203 (2026). Not kept: red-zone share, pass rate over expected, separation, pass-rush vs pass-block, run blocking, 20+ completions allowed, air-yards share (incl. RBs), practice snap limits (details in tuning_log).

changelog.change: New 'Watch sim' view for every game: one game simulated snap by snap on a broadcast-style field (numbered dots, line of scrimmage, first-down line, score bug, play-by-play), ending with a full box score.
changelog.why: Tristen: see a game play out the way the model sees it.
changelog.tested: Display only; no projection or prop changed. Checked on CHI@SEA, BAL@BUF and IND@JAX (300 games each): average points within ~1.5 of the model, player volume within ~10-15% of the main simulator (team pass/run volume tuned per game).

changelog.change: New props: longest reception (WR/TE/RB) and longest rush (RB/QB), from the simulated games (no DraftKings line; the line shown is his season average, with a 20+/30+/40+ ladder). Longest runs get a monotone stretch at the top; rush-yard totals are unchanged.
changelog.why: Tristen: receivers with big-play ability can explode for a 30+ catch; show the chance of the long play directly.
changelog.tested: 2026 Wks 3-7, model built only from earlier weeks (776 receiver and 307 rusher player-games): longest catch 10+/20+/30+/40+ modeled 65/36/17/8% vs actual 64/33/16/8% (no change needed). Longest run before the fix 67/21/4.6/1.0% vs actual 55/21/9.1/2.9%; map fit on Wks 3-5, held-out Wks 6-7 Brier 0.4851 -> 0.4712; after the fix 57/20/7.7/3.1%. A receiver's own average longest catch did not improve the prediction (MAE 9.93 model alone vs 10.02 with 25% weight on his history), because the big-play chance from air yards already carries it.

changelog.change: A weekly check of the model's over/under chances against real DraftKings lines was added (diagnostic only; not applied to the chances, at Tristen's call). Picks are re-logged when injury news changes before kickoff, props 30%+ away from the DK line are 'check news' leans instead of picks, and players with no games this season (e.g. returning from injury) are projected from their last two seasons.
changelog.why: Wks 6-8 live check (1,576 props, re-simulated from the archived pre-game builds vs closing DK lines): the raw chances scored worse than a flat 50% (Brier 0.2626 vs 0.2500; DK's own no-vig price 0.2486), the model called the under 70% of the time while 48% went over, and 80%+ calls hit 44%. Rushing chances pointed the wrong way slightly.
changelog.tested: Held-out week (fit on two weeks, scored on the third): Brier 0.2626 -> 0.2521. Volatility settings (target/carry share concentration, per-game form, yards shape) moved Brier by <0.001 and were not changed. Cannot be tested on 2023-25 (no historical DK lines); refit weekly with dk_shrink.py. The DK-line shrink (QB 0.30, receiving 0.15, rushing 0.05) was briefly applied on Nov 2 and then turned off; the model's own chances stand.

changelog.change: Defense matchups now use each defense's overall pass-defense catch-rate and yards-per-catch factors instead of separate factors for WR1 / WR2 / WR3 / TE / RB (per-role target factors off). In-season calibration refit through Wk 7.
changelog.why: Wk 7 post-mortem: role factors looked too strong (Wks 6-7 receiving yards with a factor <=0.90 went over 52% vs 41% modeled; GB@DET had 0.83-0.90 on every DET receiver, Goff 303 and St. Brown 153).
changelog.tested: Overall Brier base -> new: 2023 0.232043 -> 0.230611, 2024 0.229342 -> 0.228994, 2025 0.228279 -> 0.228277, 2026 (wks 3-7) 0.217755 -> 0.215681; receptions and receiving-yards Brier better in all four seasons. Harder shrink of the role factors also passed but by less (2026 0.217088). Rejected this week: backup-RB carry share (25%, 50%), QB carries x1.15, mid-range shrink, star trailing-script tilt, star hot streak, star weak-pass-D boost, healthy-games-only shares, lighter share shrink, stronger lead-to-run script slope (numbers in tuning_log.md).

changelog.change: Track record now logs every DraftKings prop for every player with the model's side: 'Picks' (4+ point edge, as before) and 'Leans' (all other props, incl. anytime TDs and small lines). Weeks 6 and 7 (Thursday) leans were added from the projections and lines saved before those games.
changelog.why: Requested: see how the model's side does on all props, not just the bets it flags. A logging bug had also skipped every priced 1.5 pass-TD / 1.5-reception line and all anytime TDs.
changelog.tested: n/a (record keeping). Live pick record unchanged: 217-162, +36.5u. Leans so far 284-318 (47%), -34.6u.

changelog.change: Wk 7 tune-up: tested and rejected backup-RB carry share when the lead back is out (50% and 25%), more QB carries, shrinking mid-range chances, star-receiver trailing-script target tilt, star hot-streak and weak-pass-defense boosts. Kept: in-season calibration refit through Wk 6; picks now flagged when the line moved against them.
changelog.why: Wk 6 misses (backup-RB/QB rushing unders, mid-band picks) and Tristen's star-receiver hypotheses.
changelog.tested: Overall Brier base 2023 0.232043 / 2024 0.229342 / 2025 0.228279 / 2026 0.218192. Backup RB 25%: 0.231849 / 0.229551 / 0.228125 / 0.218250 (past 3 better, 2026 worse -> rejected, re-test later); 50%: worse 2024, 2025, combined. QB carries x1.15: worse all 4. Mid-range shrink: worse 2023 and 2026. Trailing tilt: worse 2024, 2025, combined. Hot streak / weak pass D (held-out): worse in 2+ past seasons. See tuning_log.md.

changelog.change: Audit fixes: one name per player across ESPN / nflverse / snap counts (Josh Palmer, Marquise 'Hollywood' Brown, Matt Hibner, Drew Ogletree, Kenny Gainwell, Bam Knight); Travis Hunter now projected as a WR; fullbacks use the RB big-play coefficients; passing yards no longer net of sacks in 9 QB games (ESPN quirk); backup-QB scenarios keep the starter's passing anchor; track record logs one side per prop per week.
changelog.why: These players were losing their last-season prior, air yards and history (Hollywood Brown and Travis Hunter weren't projected at all; Hibner's DK TD line was dropped); QB yards were understated by 175 yds over 9 games; switching to a backup QB only moved his receivers about half as much as it should; 14 props had both sides logged.
changelog.tested: Overall Brier with the name / position / fullback fixes: 2023 0.23122→0.23115, 2024 0.22893→0.22882, 2025 0.22831→0.22826, 2026 0.22118→0.22072. In-season calibration refit.

changelog.change: Big-play chance for receivers: the chance a catch goes 20+ yards, from how far downfield he is targeted (air yards per target), now sets the starting point for his yards per catch.
changelog.why: Depth of target is the steadiest sign of big-play ability (repeats r=0.66 half to half) and predicted future yards per catch better than the flat position average (R² 0.45→0.48).
changelog.tested: Overall Brier 2023 0.23122→0.23122 (even), 2024 0.22893→0.22876, 2025 0.22831→0.22823, 2026 0.22118→0.22117; rec yds MAE better in 2023 (25.36→25.31) and 2024 (23.94→23.91). Defense 10+ runs allowed was tested in the same pass and rejected (worse 2024–2026).

changelog.change: Tested and rejected: snap-count role trend, snap-based target share, and air-yards share as inputs.
changelog.why: Better role information was expected to help.
changelog.tested: Each was worse on 2023, 2024 and 2025 (snap trend only helped 2026). Snap counts stay in the weekly post-mortem to explain misses. An upward-only snap trend (boost players whose snaps jumped 10+ points, never cut) was closer — better in 2025 and 2026, worse in 2023 and 2024 — still rejected; to be re-tested later this season. Also rejected: lineup-matched shares (role in games where the same key teammates were in/out as this week) and recent-games efficiency — both worse on the past seasons.

changelog.change: Receiving-yards chances start from a small long-run correction (~+2 points on overs) before this season's own results adjust them.
changelog.why: Receiving-yards overs hit more often than the raw simulation said in 2023, 2024 and 2026 (not 2025).
changelog.tested: Fit on the other seasons, checked on each held-out season: better in 3 of 4, better overall.

changelog.change: Tested on four seasons instead of one: 2023, 2024 and 2025 (full seasons) plus 2026 so far. A model change now has to hold up in at least 2 of the 3 past seasons, on all three combined, and this season.
changelog.why: One season can make a lucky change look real.
changelog.tested: n/a (test bed)

changelog.change: Weekly tune-up added: every completed week gets a post-mortem (each miss split into team volume, share, catch rate, yards per catch, carries, game script, snaps/injury, QB) and a small in-season correction per prop type.
changelog.why: So the model keeps learning from its own misses during the season.
changelog.tested: Corrections fit only on earlier weeks improved accuracy on all of 2025.

changelog.change: Rush attempts and rush + rec yds priced from DraftKings.
changelog.why: Requested; ESPN's feed skips some rush + rec lines.
changelog.tested: n/a (data)

changelog.change: Players with fewer than 2 games this season get half their projected share.
changelog.why: Returning / newly signed / one-game players were getting 40-60% more targets than they saw.
changelog.tested: 2026 better, 2025 unchanged.

changelog.change: When team shares add up past 100%, the excess comes first from players projected above what they've actually been getting this season.
changelog.why: Veterans on last season's role were squeezing current role players (Ridley vs Helm).
changelog.tested: Neutral overall, removes unrealistic depth-player projections.

changelog.change: Betting math fixes: parlay under/no-TD legs, best-price side, weather in logged picks, pushes on whole-number lines, zero-stat grading.
changelog.why: Third audit.
changelog.tested: Checked by hand and in the page.

changelog.change: QB carries keep their own share when backs are out; game script no longer counted twice; QB history vs opponent now opponent-adjusted.
changelog.why: Second audit: QB rushing was over-projected 10-75%.
changelog.tested: QB rushing accuracy much better on 2025 and 2026.

changelog.change: Backtest uses snap counts for who played (not who touched the ball) and the listed starting QB.
changelog.why: The old test leaked the answer.
changelog.tested: n/a (test fix)

changelog.change: Per-market fixed corrections removed; raw simulation chances used.
changelog.why: Tested on all of 2025: fixed corrections from a few weeks made the other season worse.
changelog.tested: 2025 within ~2 points per prop type.

changelog.change: Depth players no longer dilute starters' target and carry shares.
changelog.why: Deep backups were taking ~15-20% of the top receivers' targets, tilting receiving props to the under.
changelog.tested: Live shares now match the backtest.
